title: Attractap Setup
subtitle: Install firmware and configure your reader

connect.title: Connect your Attractap
connect.description: Plug your Attractap into a USB port, then click connect and pick the correct serial port in the browser dialog.
connect.bleBridgeHint: Installing firmware on an Attractap BLE Bridge (GL.iNet GL-S10)? Connect your 3.3 V USB-TTL adapter instead and put the bridge into download mode first.

bluetooth.hint: Is the firmware already on your Attractap BLE Bridge and the bridge not paired yet? Hold its button until all LEDs blink fast (about 3 seconds), then let go: the Bluetooth LED double-flashes and you can set it up without a cable. Do not hold the button for 10 seconds, that resets the bridge. This only works for the BLE Bridge.

unavailable.title: Bluetooth setup is not available in this browser
unavailable.description: Setting up over Bluetooth needs Web Bluetooth, which Chrome and Edge offer on desktop and Android (over HTTPS). Open this page there, or set the bridge up with a USB-TTL adapter, which also needs Chrome or Edge on a computer.

failed.title: Could not connect to the bridge
failed.description: Make sure the bridge's Bluetooth LED double-flashes (its setup window stays open for 10 minutes), keep it close to this device and try again. If it keeps failing, set it up with a USB-TTL adapter.

lost.title: Bluetooth connection lost
lost.description: The bridge dropped the connection: it was out of range, restarted or its 10-minute setup window closed. Settings you had not saved yet are gone. If the bridge is not paired yet, hold its button until all LEDs blink fast (about 3 seconds), let go and connect again.

closedAfterPairing.title: Bridge set up
closedAfterPairing.description: The bridge is connected to Attraccess and closed its Bluetooth connection, as expected.
